prediction_contract.prediction_time: After all allowed measurements at hour t are observed
prediction_contract.missing_pair_policy: Exclude a pair when PM2.5 at t or t+1 is missing or timestamps are not exactly one hour apart
prediction_contract.other_missing_feature_policy: Must be fixed using training-only state or explicit missing events before model preregistration

chronological_split.ordering: Strictly chronological within each station; no random row split
chronological_split.test_visibility: The immutable source archive contains all outcomes and the source audit computed whole-source aggregate completeness and class-rate statistics before this contract. Model design, feature fitting and threshold selection must not inspect test-period-specific metrics or records; the single-use evaluator may compute test-period metrics only after the model protocol is frozen.

required_baselines: bounded sparse non-spiking learner with the same visible events and update budget
next_gate: Build a deterministic processed manifest and training/development-only baseline characterization. Freeze feature bins, missingness handling, model arms, numerical thresholds and resource ceilings before any frozen-test execution.
